title: Top K Frequent Elements
prompt: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, return the k most frequent elements. You may return the answer in any order.
constraints: k is in the range [1, the number of unique elements in the array].
hints: Count the frequency of each element using a hash map.
Use a min-heap (priority queue) of size k. Keep the k most frequent elements.
Alternatively: bucket sort - create buckets where bucket[i] holds all elements with frequency i.
Bucket sort: O(n) time. Heap: O(n log k) time.
